settings.title: Siri & Shortcuts
settings.description: Log habits with your voice, a widget or the Action Button (iPhone, iPad and Mac).

steps.title: Set it up
steps.one: Create a token below and copy it.
steps.two: Install the shortcut for your language and paste the token when it asks.
steps.four: This page shows ✅ Connected after the first call.

settings.installSoon: The iCloud links aren't published yet. Build the shortcuts with the recipes in the repository (shortcuts/).
settings.names: Shortcuts: Log habit, Undo habit, How am I doing.
settings.created: Copy it now. It won't be shown again.
settings.limit: You can have up to 10 tokens.

quick.title: One tap, no voice
quick.widget: Home Screen: add the Shortcuts widget and pick “Log habit”.
quick.action: Action Button (iPhone 15 Pro and later): Settings → Action Button → Shortcut → Log habit.
quick.backTap: Back Tap: Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Back Tap → Log habit.
quick.direct: For one habit (“I meditated”), duplicate “Log habit”, remove the list, and paste the habit's ID from its page in Restart.

health.title: Apple Health
health.description: Habits with a Health rule complete themselves (iPhone only).
health.stale: No Health data for over 24 hours. Check the “Sync Health” automations.
health.guide1: Install the “Sync Health” shortcut (recipe in shortcuts/) and allow it to read Health.
health.guide2: In Shortcuts → Automation, add Time of Day automations at 12:00, 18:00 and 21:00, and 15 minutes before your daily report. Choose Run Immediately and turn off notifications.
health.guide3: Give a habit a Health rule in its editor, e.g. steps ≥ 5,000.
health.deleteConfirm: Delete all stored Health totals? Check-ins stay.
